evals.name: telegram-no-scope-question
evals.prompt: can you take a look at https://t.me/durov and tell me what that channel is actually about
evals.expected_output: Runs telegram_scrape.py for ~100 posts WITHOUT asking clarifying questions, then publishes an Artifact report covering identity, cadence, language/tone, media mix, emoji use, promotion, and engagement (median views vs 10.8M subscribers).

evals.name: youtube-vague-must-scope
evals.prompt: analyze this youtube channel for me https://www.youtube.com/@nateherk
evals.expected_output: Uses AskUserQuestion to settle depth (metadata vs watch videos) and focus BEFORE collecting. Does not silently start watching videos or dump a generic report.

evals.name: youtube-specific-focus-no-redundant-ask
evals.prompt: I want to understand exactly how https://www.youtube.com/@nateherk builds and sells n8n automations - go deep on it, watch some of his videos if you need to
evals.expected_output: Does NOT re-ask focus or depth (both already given). Runs full metadata scrape, filters to n8n videos, picks ~5 top-viewed, states picks and why, invokes the watch skill with an n8n-specific intent, publishes an Artifact reporting the actual method.

evals.name: telegram-private-channel-failure
evals.expected_output: Reports plainly that the channel is private/nonexistent/has no public preview and that this route cannot read it. Does not fabricate findings or thrash on workarounds.
